description: This file defines a mock template class 'MockStringIterator' for unit testing purposes, mocking an interface 'IStringIterator' with various methods related to iterating over string elements.

classes.name: MockStringIterator
classes.description: A mock class template for the 'IStringIterator' interface, providing mock implementations for its methods.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Mocks advancing to the next element in the iterator.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Mocks moving to the previous element in the iterator.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Mocks resetting the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Mocks checking whether the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Mocks returning the number of elements.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mocks retrieving interface pointers based on interface ID.
